discoveryMethod: separate first-party English and Chinese discovery, official-page inspection, and bounded anonymous direct retrieval attempt of the documented official geographic-information platform
sourceReview: Local custodian evidence is present: an official Anji procurement notice identifies the Anji County Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as purchaser and documents maintenance of the county's real-estate registration One-Window Cloud platform. The county public-data policy says spatial/geographic information is governed through the county public-data platform and Zhejiang's unified resource system, while the Zhejiang geographic-information platform advertises public map and developer services. This establishes a local registry/service custodian, not a qualified parcel API integration.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Anji public-resources notice identifies the Anji County Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and documents the county real-estate registration One-Window Cloud platform. No parcel geometry or machine-readable endpoint was present in the notice.

Official county public-data policy states that spatial/geographic information is handled through the county public-data platform and Zhejiang's unified resource system, with open and restricted interface categories. It does not publish a parcel feature schema or anonymous geometry route.

Official Zhejiang platform page was readable through first-party web retrieval and advertises online vector-tile maps, resource discovery, geographic information, and a developer center. The retrieved page did not expose the current JavaScript/configuration or a cadastral parcel layer.

A direct curl request from the research host failed DNS resolution before HTML/API retrieval. No TLS bypass, login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential use, or alternate certificate handling was attempted. This failure is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
